title: The Forge Spirit
text: A shape of glowing slag stirs in the ruined furnace, molten and slow, with two white-hot eyes. It speaks in the hiss of quenched steel. It offers to temper one weapon in its own heart, but it is hungry, and it wants something to burn.

options.label: Feed it a piece of good iron.

outcomes.text: It eats the iron with a hiss, and hands back a better blade.

options.label: The strongest feeds it their own heat.

outcomes.text: It drinks the warmth from their arm, leaving it grey and cold, and gives a gift for it.
It does not like that at all.
